info.title: CoreERP API reference
info.description: Reference for the Control Plane REST API.

tenant_id.description:
Binding a credential to one tenant limits the blast radius of a leaked token to that tenant. Leaving
it null preserves the older shared-app behaviour for callers that still need it.

201.description: The plaintext token is returned exactly once; Core only stores its digest.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

sessionCookie.description: Sign in through the web application to obtain the session cookie.
sessionCookie.name: coreerp-session

has_ui.description: App menyatakan punya UI. Path konten diturunkan platform dari app dan placement; app tidak mendaftarkannya.

months.description:
`months` builds evenly spaced monthly periods, which covers the ordinary case. Explicit periods stay
available for calendars that do not divide into months, such as 4-4-5.

child_role_ids.description:
Role turunan: pemegang role ini ikut memperoleh hak seluruh
turunannya. Kepemilikan tenant dan larangan lingkaran diperiksa
pada action, bukan di sini.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
